classification: single structural diversification response to R344 5x net-contribution concentration failure
hypothesis: Increasing only the A sleeve from Top10 to Top20 will reduce 5x top1/top3/top5 net contribution enough to pass the extended R344 gates without giving up the R343-level return, drawdown or breadth.
disclosure: R344 extended the frozen R343 construction to 2022-05-05 and failed the preregistered 2022 return and 5x C2-C4 concentration gates. R344 still passed 2x C1-C12, 6/6 fresh starts, overlay and asset-substitution checks. R345 changes only A max_positions from 10 to 20; all scores, B/C positions, 10% C cap, gold 200-day proxy, overlay, costs and dates remain frozen.

fixed_construction.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity across A/B/C with original [0.20,0.60] bounds; then cap C at 10% and redistribute excess proportionally to A/B
fixed_construction.defensive_bucket: gold 200-day trend proxy / 511260.SH / 510880.SH equal 1/3 monthly; when gold is OFF, its third is replaced by 50% 511260.SH plus 50% 510880.SH
fixed_construction.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross [0.2,1.0], no leverage

data.D2_curves: all A/B/C curves start 2022-05-05 and reach 2026-11-05
data.D4_a_top20_available: A strategy limit is 30 and max_positions=20 is frozen

absolute_performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

robustness.R2_gold: 159937.SZ replacement through same proxy annual >=5%, MDD >= -20%, 2024/2025 >=0
robustness.F1_fresh: at least 5/6 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, Sharpe >=1.25, MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, Sharpe >=1.10, MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 5/6 fresh starts positive
satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass and the 10% center passes

selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates and P4 must pass. Otherwise record the Top20 structural change as negative and do not promote. No threshold changes after results.
discipline: Only A max_positions changes from 10 to 20.
No score, B/C position, holding period, stop-loss, C cap, gold rule, overlay, asset or cost changes.
No additional TopN grid is run.
No leverage; no paper target or order file.
known_limitations: A Top20 is a response to the R344 failure and is post-hoc.
The extension is quasi-out-of-sample, not independent; earlier factor research may have observed the same market history.
The common window begins in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier.
Current-snapshot industry classification, reconstructed membership and ETF qfq caches are not full vendor PIT data.
